equivalence: Identical ordered item content/roles and unsorted serialized metadata across the existing one-delta fixture, third-generation fixture and bounded augmented repetition/alias fixture.
negative_controls: Wrong repeated PDF/metadata SHA or size, wrong immutable object/logical association, conflicting auxiliary path, invalid primitive kind and changed cached-delta association all reject identically. Missing/mismatched trace and general current PNG-read behavior remain identical.
byte_and_pin_contract: Function-local cache uses immutable archive SHA + object path + input SHA + bytes; each hit repeats original size/hash and delta association checks. Aliases/kinds and source associations are resolved per call; add/provenance/order logic remains intact.
protected_behavior: No global caching of data() current PNG misses.
No primitive reconstruction or downstream mandatory fresh PNG/RGB gate is skipped or changed.
No restorer, codec, native/overview renderer, collection/privacy or source/build changes.
artifact_retention: Everything remains external under /tmp. Synthetic fixture ZIP/PNG payloads and raw trial logs are not proposed publication inputs. A later collected whitelist/projection must disclose locator transformations and preserve original executed code/report identities.
install_condition: Root completes checkpoint11 restore/save and source872 integration, then separately authorizes and records installation.
